title: 79,000 Calabarzon families to be evaluated for possible 4Ps

blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — The Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) in the Calabarzon region is evaluating more than 79,000 families in Cavite, Laguna, Batangas, Rizal, and Quezon provinces as potential beneficiaries of the Pantawid Pamilyang Pilipino Program (4Ps). These families were identified as poor based on the 2024 Community-Based Monitoring System (CBMS) of the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA), according to a DSWD report on Monday. “The validation, conducted either through a house-to-house assessment or community assembly, is the initial step in the registration of beneficiaries of the 4Ps.
